args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, breaking
tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding, but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` as required by FIN-212.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on the branch head (08d3cd5986), including `tests/test_money.py`.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed**: `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring (and FIN-212, and the tests) require `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (banker's rounding) — e.g., `2.665` rounds to `2.66`, not `2.67`.
- **Fixed** on new branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding`: switched `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **Ran CI** — first run passed (ci-0001). The branch then had fallen behind main, so I merged latest main in and re-ran CI, which also passed (ci-0002 on head 0a9452f727).
- **Opened PR #101** against main, requesting review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy, I did not merge — that awaits alex's/code-owner approval.
